batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c JDS Neesham b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c KK Nair b K Gowtham

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c Q de Kock b JL Pattinson

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c TA Boult b RD Chahar

batting.name: JDS Neesham
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: Ravi Bishnoi
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b TA Boult

balls.text: that is four sixes in the over. Kings XI have been demolished here. Gowtham is a man running up to accept his punishment. Bowls in the slot again, and Pollard gives him the punishment. Another straight six
and one more. This is like stealing candy. Length-ball, in the slot, in front of the stumps, and he has just extended his arms for a six over long-on
he looks to go wide of Pollard's reach, but how do you get too wide for Pollard. The long arms catch up with the ball and smash this for a straight flat six over long-off
oh holy molly, he has missed out on this one. Sets up strong base, gets a full toss, but the bat swings a touch too early, and he gets a leading edge to long-on
now Gowtham looks to cramp Pandya up by following him, but ends up bowling in his slot. Over wide long-on for another big six
he gets away with the first one: a yorker outside off
yorker gone wrong. Full toss on the pads, and flicked away nonchalantly for four through square leg. Nineteen off that over
slower bouncer. Sits up. Hooked square of deep midwicket for four more. Mumbai have turned this around
oh that is really unfortunate. Full and fast, just outside off, slight movement away draws the outside edge, but that goes for four to third man
slower ball outside off, out of his reach, but called wide
back to yorker, smashed to long-on for one
short and wide, extra bounce, some movement away, but when you throw the bat as hard as Pandya foes, the edge is likely to clear the field. over short third this goes
yorker, straight, dug out for a single
Pollard makes room, he follows him, ends up with a high foll toss that is hit to deep midwicket for one
goes for the yorker, ends up with a low full toss, drilled to long-on for one

oh that is some hitting. Another good ball. Wide and short of a length, and off pace, but he has hit it down the ground with such power that long-off can't get around even though he has only a little distance to move

Neesham has not bowled one bad ball so far but has been taken for 12 off three balls. Pandya is moving across to set up a strong base to hit. He goes wide and short of a length, but he punches him over extra cover for four
slower legcutter this time, hit over the infield on the off side for two

this is excellent hitting. Pandya is some T20 batsman. He has just come in. This is a very good legcutter, back of a length, no room. Pandya is cramped, but somehow he funds enough power with his matchstick arms to go over long-on. Into the wind, mind

lovely yorker. Seems plumb but Pollard has reviewed it immediately. Must have hit it then. And he is right. He has got an inside edge onto his toe. Otherwise, he has gone for all money after having shuffled right in front of his stumps
draws another mis-hit. With a wide length ball this time. Slices off the outer half of his bat for a couple in front of deep cover
slower ball gone wrong. Wide down the leg side
short of a length, wide, concedes a single to deep cover
and this time he is tight on the stumps with a short-of-a-length delivery. Concedes just the single
short of a length, wide, 139ks, slight movement away, punched straight to point

relay catch first up. Shami has bowled a dangerous ball first up. Seam-up, on-pace, in the slot, but Sharma gets more air than lemgth on it. Maxwell runs to his right from long-off, is very close to the rope when he fumbles the catch, bit still holds on, recovers well and lobs it back in before going over. Neesham, the man at long-on, has done well to come backing up for the relay catch
full, into the pads, slogged to deep midwicket for one

oh he is picking his spots, which you can do against Neesham's pace. He knows the deep cover has just come in to give him a long-off so he makes room and lofts this full ball over cover. Another yorker gone wrong, it seems
he goes into the pitch but bowls seam-up and one pace. Sharma loves these 130ks short balls. Pulled over square leg for six more

another yorker gone wrong. Low full toss, and he drives it between mid-off and extra cover. He bowled so well when bowling cutters into the pitch, but yorkers are not working. Because he us missing them
Sharma shows him the shuffle across, and Neesham attempts his first yorker of the innings. It goes wrong, and he ramps him fine of long leg for four. That is fifty for Sharma too
slower short ball, at him, helped to long leg for one
slower, tossed up, pushed to short cover
short part of the field, and Sharma has picked his spot well. Shouts of catch it as he pulls one that is not short enough, but he has got enough on it to clear deep midwicket
again flat and short. Cut away to deep point
short of a length, wicket to wicket, punched to short midwicket
he goes shorter, Pollard punches this in front of deep cover, and comes back for two
oh the legspin slayer is here. Decent legbreak, on a length, outside off, and he has just lobbed it back over his head for a big six. That reach turns a good length ball into a half-volley
flat, smeared into the pads, punched past the diving short midwicket
down the wicket, not close to the pitch of the ball, pushed to long-on
stays short of the driving length again. Pushed down to long-on for one
on a length, around off, pushed to short midwicket
on a length, flat, pushed to long-on for one

Kishan has no choice but to slog-sweep the moment he sees a ball thrown up. However, the length is too full, which doesn't allow him the elevation. And he ends up drilling this straight to deep midwicket
on a length, on off, run down to point for one
short of a length, following him as he backs away, on-pace, and beats him on the bottom edge
nearly produces the wicket. Sees him back away, slips in a wide slower ball, draws the slice, but it falls between cover-point and the boundary rider
looks to pull a ball that is not short enough, and it skids on to hit his pad. The pressure has to be building up
length-ball offcutter, pushed to mid-off. No single. Off the toe end
short of a length, he throws his bat at it, gets an inside edge onto the pad
short of a length, 130ks, punched to deep cover for another single. Another excellent over from Neesham
slower legcutter, 110ks, kicks at him. Rohit throws his head back and runs this to third man for one
looks for the short legcutter, but ends up slipping it down leg
short of a length, 131ks, outside off, punched to deep point
beaten on the inside edge. Leg-bye

another catch goes down. This short ball goes big on Kishan as he looks to pull. Ends up top-edging towards midwicket. Bishnoi runs in, makes all the ground, gets under the ball, but can't hold on to it
length ball, into the pads, played along the ground to long leg
down the wicket, beaten in the flight, but ends up putting it in a hole on the leg side for a couple
looks like the googly, Sharma stays back to punch it to wide long-on
punched down to long-on for one
goes wider with the googly, draws the toe end of the bat, and fields well off his own bowling
Kishan is waiting for this wrong'un, and this is in his arc too. He slogs it over the big boundary at cow corner. Will you believe it? This is the first six of the night
flighted legbreak, pushed straight of extra cover for one
pushed down to long-on to end a cheap over for Gowtham

looks for the back cut, but finds the fielder at point. Ginger in getting back to the crease, and we go to the third umpire. He has made it, but there is something odd about the way he does it. His foot seems jammed so he extends the arm to get in just in time
flatter, shorter, punched to long-on for one
down the wicket, Gowtham pulls back the length, drawing a defensive shot
bunted into the leg side looking for two, but Kishan slips on the turn

missed run-out. Hit to the left of Gowtham and Sharma calls him through. Gowtham is caught in an awkward position where he has to run around so he gets in a feeble backhand flick allowing Kishan to get back
tries the legbreak for a change, ends up bowling it short and also giving him width. Sharma rocks back to late-cut it between point and short third
flatter googly, punched down to long-off now for one
another googly. Nice, slow and dipping. The point fielder is nice and tight to deny him this single
wrong'un, starts around middle and off, played with an open face, but straight to the fielder at point
short of a length again, punched down to long-on for one
short of a length, angling away, punched to deep cover
again off the inside half, whipped to deep midwicket for one
another shot that is hit off the inside half of the bat. Every time Kishan has looked to hit pace down the ground, he has been hit on the inside half of the bat
short of a length, pulled to deep forward square leg for one
slight movement back in from just outside off. Enough to cramp him up. A valuable dot as he plays this straight to cover-point
looks for the pick-up shot off a length on the pads, but is beaten. The ball goes hardly anywhere off the pad, but Sharma calls him through for a single
short of a length, outside off, he runs it down to third man for one
wide length ball, steered to third man for one
the first one takes the edge. An on-pace legcutter, short of a length, moves away, squares Sharma up, but the edge is too thick for Rahul to catch
off the inside half of the bat again, and this time he gets a single to mid-on. The throw hits Kishan on the calf
Kishan walks down to create a length, but Neesham sticks to his guns and bowls back of a length. Defended to cover
another slower offcutter, turns away off short of a length and beats him
slower ball first up, full outside off, hit to mid-on off the inside half of the bat
Gowatham has had a testing first over. Bowls flat, outside off, Sharma punches this beautifully, but this time Pooran gets a hand to it with a dive at extra cover. Saves two runs
offbreak, drifting in, no turn, worked to leg
slower, flighted, worked into the leg side for one
he knows what is coming next: a flatter shorter delivery, so he goes back early and cuts this in front of point. All touch
lovely shot. Backs away early, and even though Gowtham follows him with an offbreak, he punches with an open face between mid-off and extra cover
flat offbreak outside off. Doesn't turn. Beats him on the outside edge
bouncer, just outside off, he ducks it
full, just outside off, slices this over the infield. No power behind the shot as this runs off the outer half of the bat, but it manages to clear the infield
on a length, slight seam back in, or he possibly ran his fingers on it. Bowled at 135ks, so seems more like seam. Kishan has to defend
on a length, on off, angling away, runs off the face for a single
quick bouncer. Kishan, ducking for cover, manages to pull it and keep it down. Gets a single to long leg
wide down the leg side
length ball, angling in, defended to leg
not sure if this is a googly because it is so full it has no time to turn. Pushed straight of mid-off for a single

slows this down, bowls full on the pads, he sweeps it fine, calls for a single, and Surya looks like he has been run out. And he is gone. Shami is feeling his shoulder but his throw from short fine leg has done the job, catching Yadav short of his ground with a direct hit. It is Yadav's call, he has had an early start, no stutter. So he has underestimated Shami here
short slider, Sharma thinks he can hit a six, but this skids through like a flipper would, gets a bottom edge
fuller, straighter, defended back to Bishnoi
legbreak, outside off, on a length, pushed to long-off for one
slows this down, full, on off, pushed to long-off for one
wide down the leg side as he fires this one in
full, just outside off, slight movement away, resulting in a check drive to short cover
better than the last one because this is not a half-volley. He stands tall, and plays the push-drive on the up, placing it between mid-off and extra cover again
pitched too full. Looking for swing. Ends up bowling a half-volley outside off. Driven between mid-off and extra cover. All along the ground
this one goes the other way. Might have been seam as this shapes to swing back in, but pitches and keep going with the angle. Hit uppishly to cover-point
full, swinging in, played with soft hands, dropped into the covers for a single
just outside off, not enough swing, pushed wide of mid-off for one

lovely seam bowling. Given out lbw but my initial reaction is heading down leg. Rohit reviews. On a length, on off, Rohit drives, and the ball jags back in after pitching. The only questions is, is it doing too much? I think it is. HawkEye thinks it is. Rohit is reinstated
short of a length, straight, holds its line, defended back to him
another lovely shot. Just short of a length, he stays back and punches this along the ground past the man diving at cover-point
holds its line after pitching just short of a length, Rohit has to defend it
short of a length, seaming in, hits him high on the pad
5000 IPL runs for Rohit Sharma. Wide outswinger, he throws his bat at it, times it well, but it goes in the air between cover-point and cover. Kings XI excited for a moment
a wicket-maiden after that 30-run over. On a length, around off, angles away. Defended to off

special bowling. Thirty runs in his last over. Five balls, no runs and a wicket in this. Lovely seam position angling towards slip, pitches on a length, on middle and leg, drawing a shot across the line, and then swinging late to beat him and hit the timber. The Cottrell salute is alive and well
short of a length, nicely punched away, but straight to cover-point
full now, gets swing, bowls really full, 128ks, dug out back to him
short of a length, outside off, pushed with an open face to cover-point
starts with a length ball outside off, squeezes under his attempt to cut, and dies on its way to Rahul
Sahmi keeps this last yorker out to end this game
yorker, just outside off, squeezes under the bat and misses the off stump
looks for the ramp over short fine this time as Bumrah pitches it up. Off the inside half of the bat it goes, past short fine
smartly played. Bumrah bowls the short ball to cramp him up. However, this is the slower ball, giving him the time to adjust, and he ramps it over short third
full and straight, hit to extra cover
no fast bowlers' pact here. Short, into the ribs, hits the handle of the bat
oh just clears the long-off. Gets too far under this hit, sends it miles into the air, but gets enough distance on it to clear Pollard at long-off. Consolation six
wide slower ball, Gowtham throws his bat at it, gets a thick edge over short third for four
yorker, just outside leg, dug out for one, but the fielding from Boult is sensational. He gets to the ball quick, and flicks an underarm throw acrobatically
another one bites the dust. Full, straight, Bishnoi makes room, gets a thick outside edge, Yadav takes a simple catch at point
quicker, fuller, just outside off, hit to long-off for one
slower length ball, just outside off, beats his slog
quick, full, just outside off, beats him as he looks to go inside-out
quick bouncer, following him, Bishnoi sways out of the line
slower shortish ball, hit down to long-on for one
makes room, Pattinson stays full and straight, the mis-hit carries to a full-length diving Yadav at point but this is a really really difficult chance
on a length, outside off, Surya Yadav makes another diving save at point

yorker, given lbw, but he reviews it. It seems he might have hit it, but this has swung as it goes past the bat, and hits him on the toe in front of the stumps. Plumb as. Was that reverse? It went really late
full ball, just outside off, drilled wide of sweeper cover for two
on a length, angling in, cramps him up. Hit back to Boult
looks for the ramp, sees the short ball, keeps his stance and looks to pull. Is done in by the slower delivery, and is hit on the helmet
yorker outside off, dug out for a single to extra cover
yorker outside off, dug out for one
shot of the night even though the game is dead. Sarfaraz plays the reverse pull to hit this length ball over short third after switching his stance

full toss, on off, gets big on him, for a catch at point. They will check the height of the full toss, though. Has dipped just enough in the nick of time. So it is a fair delivery, and another wicket goes down
Bumrah has that fine leg fine as we mentioned earlier in the over. Bumrah knows the ramp is in play if he spears them in from wide on the crease. Except that it gets Sarfaraz only one run
wide on the crease again, punched with an open face, and Surya Yadav goes flying at point to save four runs
swipes a wide length ball across the line to deep midwicket for one
angling in from wide on the crease, hits the pad, and accordingly for that angle, his fine leg is fine to prevent the boundary off the tickle
wide on the crease, angles a length ball in, hits him high on the bat
worked into a hole on the leg side for a couple
angular run this time, and he keeps bowling the slow legbreaks. Maxwell plays the desperate slog, but this ball is not full enough for the shot. Deep midwicket takes the catch
straight run this time, and he bowls a really slow legbreak, beating the Maxwell switch hit for the pace
he makes that angular run he does at death these days, and bowls a straight legbreak. Worked around the corner for one
looks to pull, gets a bottom edge to deep square leg
quick legbreak, outside off, defended back to him because of the turn
yorker planned, yorker executed. Just the single off. Good way to close out an excellent over
bouncer, Neesham goes back to pull it down. Gets a single
full and straight, flicked away in the air, gets two to deep midwicket
that has gone like an offcutter. This is not a slower ball. Clocked at 135ks. Short of a length, outside leg, then squares him up with the away movement and beats him
on-pace this time. Seam-up, full, just outside off, and there has been some movement available today if you land it on the seam. This one deviates enough to take the edge. That is a huge wicket
gets away with one. Seems like an offcutter from Pattinson. Pooran sees one in the slot, looking to go voer long-off. The thick outside edge lands short of sweeper cover
excellent comeback over. Bowls a low wide full toss, it straight to cover-point. Pandya has done his job
lovely wide yorker. On top of that blue tram line. Maxwell leaves it alone. Not called a wide
again bowls that length to deny him an aerial hit. Right at his heel. Dug out for a single to deep midwicket. Hardik Pandya does well to deny them the second
on a length, no pace to work with, pushed towards long-off for one
on off, really full, doesn't let him get under it. Dug out for one. Good bowling
oh he goes for the surprise full straight ball. Driven wide of long-on for two
yorker, on the pads, dug out for one. So despite that boundary, just the seven off
angling in, he shuffles across to work this to leg for one
on a length, outside off, crunches sweetly, but straight to extra cover
short of a length, pitches outside leg, angles towards off, runs this down to third man
lovely shot. Doesn't matter if you are Bumrah. If you bowl short at not high pace, Pooran is going to hurt you. Pulls this over midwicket for a four
on a length, no room, pushed back towards him
looks for the sweep, Chahar does well to slow it down and beat him in the air, but he gets a bottom edge on the sweep, which fetches him three runs
short and wide again, cut away past the diving man at point
Pooran is on fire here. Picks the length early to rock back and pull this shortish delivery over wide long-on for six more
shuffles across to slog this to deep midwicket
again the slow wide legbreak just like Chahal bowls to Maxwell. He tries to skip down the track, but gets an outside edge over slip

big appeal for lbw as he beats him on the sweep. Not given, but MI review. If it is the legbreak, has it straightened enough? No it is the wrong'un. Is it full enough to be pitching within the stumps and hitting them too? I suspect this is pitched outside leg. And it is pitched well outside leg. Good decision by the on-field umpire: he picked the googly and decided it had to be pitching outside if it was hitting the stumps
short of a length, some width, punched to deep point for one
short of a length, straight, pushed down towards long-on
short of a length, wicket to wicket, played with soft hands for a single towards point
same length but gives him the width to throw his arms at. Goes flying over point
seam movement?. On a length, middle and leg, lands on seam, moves away, beats him
short of a length, quick, draws an inside edge for one
flatter, into the pads, worked to leg for one
Chahar is bowling like Chahal to Maxwell: slow wide legbreaks. He beats him again
lovely slow legbreak again, and beats Maxwell again. This isn't a wide either
short of a length, outside off, no turn, cut away for one
short of a length, just outside off, punched to long-off for one
really slow, wide legbreak. Maxwell is beaten, but it is called wide
top of leg stump. Rahul is looking for the lap sweep, but the Chahar legbreak doesn't turn as he expects it to. That means he misses it, and the leg stump is left exposed. Chahar takes it
on a length, no room, worked to leg for one
short of a length, wide, punched to deep cover
moves across early, Pandya fires one in, looking for the yorker, Pooran gets an outside edge and the pace on the ball does the job of beating short third
and now he gets one in the slot. On a length, just outside off, turning in, and he has slog-swept this to Dubai, it would appear. Lands on the grass banks
moves across this time, Pandya goes wider, and has been called for it
wide length ball as Pooran stands his ground this time. Called wide this time
flatter, quicker, fuller, straighter. Pushed back to him
stays away from his reach but gets inside the tram line. Beats him on the cut
wide length ball, too wide
wrong'un, goes back to cut this to deep point for one
nice legbreak, dipping, on a length, just outside of,f turning back in, beating him but turning too far down for the lbw
short of a length, stays low, pulled to wide long-on for one
looks for the paddle sweep, doesn't get the full length, but goes ahead with it and takes a single
some turn from short of a length, worked to leg
on a length, straight, pushed back to him
full, straight, driven to long-on
on a length, outside off, punched to deep cover

bowled'im. This plan of left-arm spin in the Powerplay has worked. He has given them nothing so far. Nair looking to manufacture a late cut, but Pandya stays on a length and draws the bottom edge into the stumps
quick, into the pads, worked to short fine leg
short of a length, off the bottom edge, single to point
down the wicket with no intent to hit a six. Pushes this back to him
wide length ball, pushed to point

BOOM BOOM. You could just see that business had picked up this over. This is lovely bowling. After troubling him last two balls, he bowls a full ball just outside off with a Shami-like seam position. And he draws seam movement to rush through the gate
short of a length, no room, played to point
short of a length, holds its line, hits him high on the pad
full, into the pads, worked away to long leg
beats him for pace first up, hits the pad, but is headed down leg
on a length, straight, punched down the ground
full toss, hit to mid-on for a quick single
short of a length, straight, punched to deep midwicket
slow, on a length, slight turn, inside edge onto the pad
flat, into the body, pulled to deep midwicket
tossed up outside off, driven to the extra cover placed straight
opens the face for a single
short of a length, outside off, this time he manages to place this well square of deep point. Also the fielder had moved in front of square a little
wide length ball, driven to deep point for one
on a length, outside off, driven on the up, straight to extra cover
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep point
lovely timing. On a length, angling away, just a push, gets a couple in front of deep point
on a length, angling in, uses soft hands to play it in front of deep square for a couple
on a length, on off, pushed to mid-off
short of a length, down the leg side, wide
on a length, outside off, pushed wide of mid-off
on a length, angling in, worked to square leg
tucked away off the hip, square of long leg
Agarwal in scintillating form. Makes room to cut this perfctly okay delivery - short of a length, at the stumps - over cover for four

that's a better bouncer. Right at his badge, and quicker too, draws the mis-hit, but Krunal Pandya has misjudged the catch at long leg. Can't even get a hand to it. Charges in and the runs to his left
runs this down to third man for one
short of a length, on the pads, clipped away in front of long leg
on a length, slight swing, defended back to him
short ball, 136ks, good height, but Agarwal is in excellent form and has smacked this clean over forward square leg for four
some swing first up, but down the leg side and clipped away for one
